messages: The coffee maker showed up with a cracked water tank, and water leaks out when I fill it.
My package was crushed on one side, and the lamp inside has a bent base. Can you help me get a replacement?
I opened the box and found the mug in pieces. It was wrapped in just one thin layer of bubble wrap.
The new desk has a deep gouge across the top. I haven’t assembled it yet, but it’s clearly not usable as is.
The frame came with a corner chipped off. I’d rather swap it than try to patch it myself.
Hi, the blender’s plastic pitcher is split near the handle. I noticed it as soon as I unpacked everything.
The glass jar didn’t make it through shipping in one piece. There were shards loose in the box, too.
My headphones have a snapped piece on the headband, even though the outer carton looked fine.
The chair I received has a cracked leg. I’m not comfortable sitting on it, so please let me know what to do next.
The screen on the monitor has a long crack across it. I took photos of the box and the display if that helps.
The plate set arrived with three plates chipped around the edges. Could you send replacements for those?
Not a great first impression—the toaster has a dent in the side and the lever is stuck down.
